resources.string: Enter2Send
Desktop-style sending for physical keyboards on Android and Samsung DeX.
Makes Enter send in explicitly enabled, supported chat composers when their Send control is unambiguous. ChatGPT text is checked only for emptiness; contents are never logged or stored.
Works only in the apps you enable. ChatGPT text is checked only for emptiness; contents are never logged or stored.
Open accessibility settings

If Android stops the service after you close apps, allow Enter2Send to run in the background. In system app settings, check battery restrictions and background autostart if available. Keep the app in Recents when your device requires it.
Open Enter2Send app settings
Enter-to-send enabled
Pause every Enter2Send integration without revoking accessibility access.

Accessibility service: ON

Enter2Send can receive physical keyboard events for supported apps.
Enable the service before testing any app switch.
Verified in normal Chat and Remote. Enabled by default.
Verified in Messenger chats. Opt in when you want Enter to send.
Remote Control only. Ordinary Claude chats and Dispatch stay native.
Keyboard controls

Enter / Numpad Enter / Ctrl+Enter • Send
Shift+Enter • New line

After a successful send, Enter2Send waits for the app to clear its Send control before restoring composer focus.
Safe by design

No network permission, telemetry, message-content logging or storage, custom keyboard, coordinate taps, or gesture injection. If the composer or Send control is unclear, the key passes through unchanged.
Tip: if an app already offers its own Enter-to-send setting, use that instead.
